content:
We need to find template that corresponds to Wolff-Kishner reduction retrosynthesis: target is ketone (CC(=O)C) to alkane (propane). In retrosynthesis, we go from ketone to hydrazone precursor? Actually retrosynthetic step: ketone -> hydrazine + base -> alkane. So the template should break C=O to C-H and N-N? The forward reaction: ketone + hydrazine -> hydrazone, then base -> alkane + N2. So retrosynthetic transformation: alkane -> ketone? Wait we need to apply template to target molecule (ketone) to get precursors (hydrazone + base?). The task: "return the mapped_rxn associated with the template that, when applied to the molecule below, reproduces the reaction: For fully reducing a ketone into an alkane, the Wolff-Kishner reduction can be employed." So we need template that when applied to ketone gives precursors (hydrazine etc). So we need to search for template where functional_groups_broken includes "ketones" and functional_groups_formed includes "alkane". Already attempted but got many unrelated templates. Maybe need to search for templates where broken includes "ketones" and formed includes "alkanes"? But "alkane" not in list. The functional groups list includes "alkyl halide", "alkyl"? Not. So maybe we need to search by bonds broken/formed. The O-H bond broken? Actually O-H not present in ketone. The O-H bond of the ketone is broken? The carbonyl O-H? Not. The hint says O-H bond of the ketone is broken (maybe they refer to O-H in hydrazone?). Anyway.

Alternative: Use get_available_functional_groups to see list.
